description: Create a neighborhood tool lending library tracker spreadsheet. Set up columns for: Tool Name, Owner, Current Status, Borrowed By, Checkout Date, Days Out (calculated), and Notes. Enter 10 tools from the neighborhood (Chainsaw-Martinez, Pressure Washer-Chen, Tile Saw-Johnson, Extension Ladder-Park, Power Drill Set-Rodriguez, Leaf Blower-Martinez, Wet/Dry Vacuum-Thompson, Circular Saw-Chen, Hedge Trimmer-Park, Post Hole Digger-Johnson). Record 4 current checkouts: Pressure Washer to Rodriguez (3 days ago), Extension Ladder to Thompson (5 days ago), Power Drill Set to Martinez (9 days ago - OVERDUE), Circular Saw to Johnson (2 days ago). Create a Days Out formula using TODAY() that calculates days since checkout. Flag items over 7 days as overdue. Save as /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/neighborhood_tool_library.xlsx.
